title: files settings
description: Operator settings for the files module (company.yaml modules.files). Secrets (API token, share link secret, encryption keys, S3 credentials) are never settings; can-core generates the first three as Secrets.

max_file_mb.description: The largest file accepted, in MiB. Uploads are streamed, so this does not raise the memory the service needs.

quota_gb_per_owner.description: Storage one space owner may use across the spaces they own.

trash_days.description: A deleted file is purged this many days later (0: never). A legal hold or an unpassed retention date stops the purge.

scanner_required.description: Refuse every upload while no real virus scanner is wired in (default true). Turn off only for development.

inline_images.description: Allow ?inline=1 for raster images (png, jpg, gif, webp), served sandboxed. Everything else is always an attachment. Default false.
